summary.text: John Peterson, a Republican hotel banquet supervisor and campaign volunteer, lost the November 3, 2026 election for the U.S. House in South Carolina's 6th District to Jim Clyburn.
He challenged Democratic Rep. Jim Clyburn, who had held the seat for 33 years.

paragraphs.text: Peterson earned a bachelor's degree from the State University of New York at Brockport.
He works as a banquet supervisor at Embassy Suites in North Charleston, South Carolina; WCSC described him as a former mathematician who works at the North Charleston Convention Center.
Peterson has volunteered for Donald Trump's campaigns, canvassing in North Carolina in 2020 and, in 2024, making phone calls and canvassing in South Carolina.
He received 30.5% of the vote to Jim Clyburn's 69.4%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
